title: Say Boses manlapud Kaaralman
intro: Say istorya na anos tan say andi-anggaan a panangasi na Dios so nibaga ed Quran. Sakey a mensahero so nibaki ed sakey a baleg a siudad, balet ag inawat na saray totoo ra so pasakbay tan impulisay da so katuaan. Lapud inkadismaya, sayan kamarerwa so tinmaynan — pian labat nasubok na mansasnit a dayat tan inakmon ed sankabilungetan a kaaralem. Manlapud eges na kabilungetan, linmesa so mapaabeban kerew, tan inmebat so Sankamapangasi. Siopa yan kamarerwa ya pinmaway ya apasimbalo, ya saray totoo to et magmaliw ya mananisia na masulok ya sanlasus libo?
clues: Nibaki ak a managpasakbay ed sakey a baleg a siudad a saray manaayam to et sinmian ed dalan na pananisia.
Aminpigak ya tinawag iray totook ed katuaan, balet inelek-elekan tan impulisay day mensahek.
Tinaynan ko ra lapud inkadismaya antis ya naikdan na permiso, tan linma ak ed gilig na dayat.
Walay baleg a bagyo, tan siak so nibantak ed dayat — insan ak inakmon na sakey a baleg a pinalsa ed dayat.
Diad saray lapis na kabilungetan — say kaaralem na dayat, say eges na pinalsa, tan say dalem na dayat — inmeyag ak: 'Anggapoy dios no ag Sika; gloria ed Sika; Kaiba ak ed saray nanggawa na mauges.'
Inliktar ak nen Allah manlapud kaaraleman, tan nen pinmawil ak, masulok a sanlasus libo ed saray totook so angawat ed katuaan.

identity.label: Siopa ak?
options: Propeta Yunus (Jonah)
Propeta Musa (Moses)
Propeta Ibrahim (Abraham)
Propeta Zakariyya (Zacarias)
Propeta Idris (Enoc)

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Say inakmon na baleg ya pinalsa ed dayat
Manpapaarap ed sakey a managpairap tan saray salamangkero to
Say pangibantak ed manliob ya apoy na sakey ya ari ya mansyodot
Makadngel na maliket a balita nipaakar ed sakey ya anak a laki legan ya masiken la tan agmakayari
Naimatonan so sakey a bansan aderal lapud makadesyang a delap
trial.answer: Say inakmon na baleg ya pinalsa ed dayat

location.label: Manunan Elemento
options: Say eges na sakey a baleg a pinalsa ed dayat diad kaaralem na dayat
Sakey a sagradon abung ya apaliberan na kapalandeyan diad sakey ya ag-ontutubo a lawak
Sakey a mandarlang ya apoy ya ginawan ambetel tan mareen
Sakey a marakdakep a hardin a walaan na onaagus iran ilog tan anino
Sakey a baleg a biong ya akaalagey ed toktok na palandey
location.answer: Say eges na sakey a baleg a pinalsa ed dayat diad kaaralem na dayat

outcome.label: Pansumpalan
options: Niliktar ed kabilungetan; dakel a totoo so anisia
Nibulos ed manliob ya apoy, ya saray ngalab et onkakapuy
Nagmaliw ya lider na sakey a makapanyarin bansa tan imbulos to ra ed panagpairap
Naikdan na anak ed inkatatken kayari na dakel a taon ya impanpikasi
Naikdan na baleg a kakabatan, sakey a panarian, tan pananguley ed saray dagem tan jinn
outcome.answer: Niliktar ed kabilungetan; dakel a totoo so anisia

arabic: فَلَوْلَا كَانَتْ قَرْيَةٌ ءَامَنَتْ فَنَفَعَهَآ إِيمَـٰنُهَآ إِلَّا قَوْمَ يُونُسَ لَمَّآ ءَامَنُوا۟ كَشَفْنَا عَنْهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْخِزْىِ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَمَتَّعْنَـٰهُمْ إِلَىٰ حِينٍۢ
verse: Then has there not been a [single] city that believed so its faith benefited it except the people of Jonah? When they believed, We removed from them the punishment of disgrace in worldly life and gave them enjoyment [i.e., provision] for a time. (10:98)
